model_recommendations.preferred_model: Core FCFF using IFRS operating profit with SBC retained + nonconsolidated investments SOTP; distinguish NCI and liquidity claims.
model_recommendations.operating_tax_rate_assumption: 18%-22% sensitivity; 20% central possible assumption, not disclosed core rate. H1 current tax 24392 / consolidated pre-tax143659 is not pure operating tax.
model_recommendations.sbc: Full group SBC 27.511bn TTM to undo nonIFRS EBIT; only equity-settled23.309bn when undoing CFO noncash addback. Existing grant claims separate.
model_recommendations.prepayment: 51.4bn Q2 compute prepayment is already in CFO. Normalize timing only with matching future run-rate investments/commitments; no double subtraction.
model_recommendations.lease: If lease payments treated as operating, retain cash lease costs and do not subtract same18.865bn lease liability; alternatively financing approach needs lease reinvestment and cash-tax adjustments.
model_recommendations.nci: 6/30 book86.660bn not fair market NCI. TTM NCI earnings5.893bn provides conditional equity-claim proxy, not audited fair value. Put6.117bn may overlap NCI; reconcile before addition.
model_recommendations.cash: Company total cash excludes separately shown restricted7.729bn; retained operational/customer capital not fully disclosed. Retain working liquidity reserve as explicit assumption.
model_recommendations.investments: June listed487.2bn and unlisted387.9bn are dated references, not October NAV. July Kuaishou sale and Kling subscription are asset conversions, not added free value.
model_recommendations.dilution: Legal9.092645bn minus pending.003759bn =9.088886bn before trust/award reconciliation. Sensitivity around9.09-9.20bn is modeling assumption, not verified fully diluted share count.

source_conflicts.resolution: Use filing; database adjusted classification not fully reconciled. financial_rigor cross-validate median-based deviations <1% must not override substantive1.683% pairwise difference.
Database CFO-PPE excludes intangible/media25.399bn and leases7.555bn, partly offset land refund. Database FCF cannot be treated as Tencent distributable cash.
Debt gap18865 equals lease liabilities. Cash scope gap52250 not fully decomposed; do not average figures.
